dct_description_sm:
Features related to provincially tracked species and species at risk are not available as open data. Sensitive features are subject to licensing and approvals. Visit the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry website to get access to natural heritage information. 

Provincially tracked species (in this context only) include: species listed as species at risk under Canadas Species at Risk Act or Ontario's Endangered Species Act, other species that are rare in Ontario, or that are of conservation concern, Provincially Tracked Species not included in this layer are: wildlife concentration areas like heronries, colonial waterbird colonies, bat hibernacula, and waterfowl, shorebird and winter raptor concentration areas, and plant communities.
